verdict.rationale: New Relic AI lets users ask questions, troubleshoot issues, and explore telemetry in plain language, and can help fix NRQL queries (docs-9, docs-10). The official MCP server converts plain-English questions into NRQL, so natural-language querying also works from external AI tools (docs-22, docs-36). The vulnerability agent shows some agentic action, triaging CVEs and opening Jira or GitHub issues (docs-41, docs-49). missing for 10: evidence that natural-language commands can create or change configuration such as alerts, dashboards, or SLOs (not just query and explore data), and independent or hands-on corroboration of how well the natural-language features work.
